import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Top left: Revenue by product category
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars1 = ax1.bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values)
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top middle: Sales distribution by time of day
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax2.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_title('Hourly Sales Pattern', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Top right: Payment method distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, 
                                    textprops={'fontsize': 11})
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Bottom left: Revenue by age group and takeaway status
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
age_takeaway_revenue = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_takeaway_revenue.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, width=0.8)
ax4.set_title('Revenue by Age Group & Takeaway Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(['Dine-in (0)', 'Takeaway (1)'], title='Takeaway Status')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 5. Bottom middle: Price distribution by size
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='size', y='price', order=size_order, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)

# 6. Bottom right: Quantity heatmap by product and size
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
heatmap_data = df.pivot_table(index='product', columns='size', values='quantity', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
heatmap_data = heatmap_data[['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']]
sns.heatmap(heatmap_data, annot=True, fmt='.0f', cmap='YlOrRd', linewidths=0.5, ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'label': 'Total Quantity'})
ax6.set_title('Total Quantity Sold: Product × Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
